Terms of Use

By continuing to use Doki Duck AI, you acknowledge that this application is a private entertainment and learning project. It is provided for experimentation, conversation, grammar practice and general amusement.

1. Player profile. You may provide a username and age during first use. The application stores profile and game-progress information on the device so that progress can survive closing and reopening the application.

2. Visible profile information. In a future shared leaderboard, your chosen username, XP, level and selected achievements may be displayed to other players. Do not choose a username that contains information you do not want other players to see.

3. Progress and achievements. Pond Points, XP, worms, Doki growth, achievements and related progress are game data. Doki makes no promise that your score will improve your social standing, intelligence, employability or relationship with ducks.

4. Grammar learning. Grammar feedback is provided as a learning aid and may occasionally be incomplete, incorrect or unavailable. It should not be treated as professional language instruction.

5. Images and third-party material. Some images, illustrations, sounds or other materials displayed by the application may be sourced from third-party resources or supplied by the developer. The application does not claim ownership of material that belongs to another rights holder. If a rights holder believes material has been used improperly, the developer may remove or replace it.

6. No warranty. The application is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. Bugs, broken buttons, confused ducks, missing worms and other technical failures are possible. The developer is not liable for ordinary inconvenience, lost game progress or Doki's opinions.

7. Satirical references. References to products, companies, services or artificial-intelligence systems, including ChatGPT and Claude, are used solely as satire, parody or comedic comparison. They are not intended to state or imply sponsorship, endorsement, affiliation, partnership or defamation.

8. Content and conduct. You are responsible for the information you enter. Do not enter passwords, financial information, private documents or other information that you would not want stored or processed by the application.

9. Changes. Features, game rules, rewards, grammar systems, images and other parts of the application may change during development. The developer may reset or alter game mechanics when necessary to fix bugs or improve the prototype.

10. Acceptance. By selecting the acceptance button below, you confirm that you have read this document and agree to use the application on that basis.
